mapper.select: UPDATE membership SET status = 'suspended', version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE id = #{membershipId} AND NOT deleted RETURNING tenant_id, version
UPDATE membership SET version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE id = #{membershipId} AND NOT deleted RETURNING tenant_id, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership (id, identity_id, tenant_id, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{identityId}, #{tenantId}, 'invited', now(), now(), NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (identity_id, tenant_id) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id AS membership_id, status FROM membership WHERE identity_id = #{identityId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted

SELECT m.id AS membership_id, m.status AS membership_status, t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, i.id AS identity_id, i.status AS identity_status FROM membership m JOIN identity i ON i.id = m.identity_id JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.id = #{membershipId} AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT i.deleted AND NOT t.deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE membership SET status = 'active', updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE id = #{membershipId} AND status = 'invited' AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM membership WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{membershipId} AND NOT deleted)

SELECT m.id AS membership_id, i.account, i.display_name, m.status, m.attributes::text AS attributes FROM membership m JOIN identity i ON i.id = m.identity_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT i.deleted ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM membership m JOIN identity i ON i.id = m.identity_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT i.deleted
SELECT attributes::text FROM membership WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{membershipId} AND NOT deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE membership SET attributes = CAST(#{attributes} AS jsonb), updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{membershipId} AND NOT deleted
